description: Add one empty shot (no cast, no scenery items; place, light and look carry on from the shot before, like the app's + Shot). By default it goes right after the shot on screen. Returns the new shot id. Then fill it with set_cast, direct_cast, set_text, set_camera, set_light, set_place and set_transition. One undo step for the person. For a new place or moment use add_scene; to copy a shot use duplicate.

after.description: Put it right after this shot id.

first.description: With scene: put it first in the scene instead.

place.description: Place preset id, with its scenery. Ids must come from the current style: call library to see them (a wrong id is refused with the valid list).

scene.description: Or: add it at the end of this scene (id or index).

seconds.description: Length in seconds (3 if left out).

name: add_shot
